text: Risk evaluation produces a decision that blocks, allows, or sends the transaction to review
quote: The risk evaluation reaches a decision that results in an action to block, allow, or review the transaction.

text: A default, pre-configured risk profile is available to get started with risk management
quote: When you configure risk management for the first time, a default risk profile is available to help you get started.

text: Risk profiles control which risk rules apply to payments on a merchant account
quote: Risk profiles let you manage which risk rules you apply to payments made on a merchant account.

text: Risk settings can be overridden per merchant account instead of using company-wide settings
quote: To change risk settings for a specific merchant account, switch to that merchant account and select the Override company settings checkbox.

text: Machine learning risk engine scores fraud risk using Adyen's global transaction data
quote: Our risk engine uses machine learning and Adyen's global transaction data to evaluate the fraud risk of transactions.

text: Merchants can build custom risk rules tailored to their own fraud risks
quote: Build your own custom risk rules around the unique fraud risks faced by your business.

text: Block and allow risk lists based on Adyen data, merchant data, or third-party lists
quote: Risk lists, also called block and allow lists or referrals, let you block or allow a transaction based on Adyen's data, your own data, or lists provided by third parties.

text: Referrals API automates uploading referral lists to block and trust lists
quote: You can use our Referrals API to automate uploading lists of referrals and referral details to block and trust lists.

text: Reviewers handle flagged cases in the Customer Area and accept or reject transactions
quote: A reviewer then accesses the case in the Customer Area and accepts or rejects the transaction.

text: Rules decide which card payments go through 3D Secure and whether they are challenged
quote: Set up rules to determine which card payments are routed through 3D Secure authentication, and if they should be challenged.

text: Shopper DNA links transaction data points to reveal networks connecting individual shoppers
quote: By combining transaction data points, shopper DNA uncovers the networks that connect individual shoppers.

text: Retrieve dispute information, defend or accept disputes, and upload defense documents
quote: You can retrieve dispute information, defend or accept disputes, and upload defense documents.

text: Risk experiments A/B test two risk profiles against each other to compare performance
quote: Risk experiments let you A/B test two risk profiles against each other to determine which performs better.

text: Data collection SDK can be added to website pages to gather shopper device and behavior data
quote: how to optionally add the data collection SDK to other pages in your website.

text: Webhooks and payment responses can include risk details such as triggered rules and case management status
quote: You can include risk information, such as whether a payment was sent to case management, and which risk rules triggered in these webhooks, as well as in the payment response.

text: Webhooks deliver asynchronous status changes so you do not need to poll the API
quote: With webhooks, you can avoid having to continuously poll an API endpoint, waiting for a change in status for an asynchronous process

text: Official MCP server lets you work with Adyen in natural language from an LLM client
quote: Our Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets you use natural language with your chosen Large Language Model (LLM) client.

text: API definitions are published for import into tools like Postman
quote: we recommend you use Postman to import the API definition and create your personal collection of requests.

text: Backtest risk rules against historical data before going live
quote: Risk Rule Backtesting. Test and optimize risk rules against historical data before going live.
